title: Assign Student – Add Student Picker – Lesson Allocation Archived – Student Not Selectable
description: Feature Impact (LA authorization & Add Student) - Decision Table: the Add Student picker on a Lesson must exclude a student whose Lesson Allocation has been archived by the Lesson Allocation soft-delete, so staff cannot manually assign them.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- A lesson exists for Course Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ on 2026-05-20.
- Student A has a Lesson Allocation for Math 101 that has been archived (Archived_At__c is populated) after its Student Package Order was fully removed.
- Student B has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 (Archived_At__c is blank).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson on 2026-05-20 and clicks Add Student"
2. "HQ or CM Staff searches for Student B"
3. "HQ or CM Staff searches for Student A"
4. "HQ or CM Staff selects Student B and clicks Save"
5. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student B's Lesson Allocation record"
6. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so Student A's Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
7. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the lesson on 2026-05-20, clicks Add Student, and searches for Student A"
8. "HQ or CM Staff selects Student A and clicks Save"
9. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation record"
steps_result:
1. "The Add Student search modal opens"
2. "Student B appears in the picker results"
3. "Student A does not appear in the picker results"
4. "Student B is assigned to the lesson; a Student Session is created"
5. "Lesson Allocated count has incremented by 1; Lesson Allocation Status reflects the active assignment; Report History shows the new lesson entry"
6. "Student A's Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
7. "Student A now appears in the picker results"
8. "Student A is assigned to the lesson; a Student Session is created"
9. "Lesson Allocated count has incremented by 1; Lesson Allocation Status reflects the active assignment; Report History shows the new lesson entry, consistent with an LA that was never archived"
steps_data:
1. ""
2. "Student B Lesson Allocation Archived_At__c = blank -> shown"
3. "Student A Lesson Allocation Archived_At__c populated -> hidden"
4. ""
5. "Student B LA detail fields updated correctly after assignment"
6. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
7. "Student A Archived_At__c = blank (restored) -> shown"
8. ""
9. "Student A LA detail fields updated correctly after assignment"

title: Assign Student – Add Student Popup (REST-Backed Path) – Lesson Allocation Archived – Student Not Selectable (Control Case, Second Code Path)
description: Regression / control case - Decision Table: found during a sweep of whether Nichibei forks the Add Student popup from Core (it doesn't). The modal calls /services/apexrest/MANAERP/lessonAllocations/retrieve/v1 -> LessonAllocationHandler.cls:92, a second, previously unenumerated query path distinct from the LessonMasterHandler.cls:46 query, independently confirmed to already filter Archived_At__c = NULL.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- A lesson exists for Course Math 101 on 2026-05-20. Student A has a Lesson Allocation for Math 101 archived (Archived_At__c populated). Student B has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson's Student tab and clicks Add Student"
2. "HQ or CM Staff searches for Student A and Student B"
steps_result:
1. "The Add Student modal opens, backed by LessonAllocationHandler.cls:92 via the REST retrieve endpoint"
2. "Student A does not appear (Archived_At__c populated -> excluded); Student B appears (Archived_At__c blank -> shown)"

title: Assign Student – Lesson Roster – Lesson Allocation Archived After Assignment – Student No Longer Shown
description: Feature Impact (Student Session lifecycle) - Decision Table: after a student is assigned to a lesson, if their Lesson Allocation is later archived by the Lesson Allocation soft-delete, the student must no longer appear in the lesson's student roster / attendance list, even though their Student Session record is not deleted.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- A lesson exists for Course Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ on 2026-05-20.
- Student A has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 (Archived_At__c is blank) and has already been assigned to the lesson - an active Student Session exists, Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson on 2026-05-20 and views the Student Sessions / attendance list"
2. "The Student Package Order behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the same lesson's Student Sessions / attendance list"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Student Session record directly by its record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation record while it is still archived"
6. "A living Student Package Order reappears for the same Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
7. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the lesson's Student Sessions / attendance list"
8. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation record"
steps_result:
1. "Student A is listed"
2. "The Lesson Allocation record shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "Student A no longer appears in the list"
4. "The Student Session record still exists with its original attendance/report data; it was not deleted"
5. "Lesson Allocated count and Report History retain the values they had before archiving - archive performs no DML on these fields, only on Archived_At__c"
6. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
7. "Student A reappears in the list - the same original Student Session, not a new one"
8. "Lesson Allocated count, Lesson Allocation Status, and Report History match the values from before the archive, with no duplicate entries or lost history"
steps_data:
1. "Student A Student Session Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> shown"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A Student Session Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden"
4. "Record preserved for history/restore"
5. "Fields unchanged by the archive write"
6. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
7. "Student A Student Session Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored) -> shown again"
8. "LA detail fields consistent across the archive -> restore round trip"
